get_shard_dims_collect: recursively traverse a PyTorch module and collect sharding information from all Sharded submodules
get_shard_dims_return: return a dictionary mapping fully qualified parameter names to their sharded tensor dimensions
Sharded_get_shard_dims: implement the abstract get_shard_dims method to return a list of tuples with sharded parameters and their dimensions
Sharded_interface: create a PyTorch module that implements the Sharded interface to indicate tensor-sharded parameters
Sharded_example: use ColumnShardedLinear as an example of a module implementing the Sharded interface for column-wise sharding
